question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Go to https://passwords.novatech.com, click Forgot Password, enter your employee ID (e.g. NT10432), verify with the one-time code sent to your personal email or Okta Verify, and set a new password. It applies to all SSO apps within five minutes. If you are locked out, call IT on extension 2020.

question: My account is locked. What should I do?
answer: After 5 failed attempts your account locks for 30 minutes and then unlocks automatically. For faster help, call the IT Service Desk on extension 2020 (+1 612-555-2020), 7 AM to 9 PM CT, Monday to Saturday.

question: How often do I need to change my password?
answer: SSO passwords expire every 90 days. You receive reminders 14, 7 and 1 day before expiry. Passwords need at least 12 characters with an upper-case letter, a number and a symbol, and cannot reuse your last 5 passwords.

question: How do I connect to the VPN?
answer: Open GlobalProtect on your company laptop, enter the portal vpn.novatech.com if asked, sign in with your SSO credentials and approve the Okta Verify push. The icon shows a shield with a check mark when connected. Personal devices cannot use the VPN.

question: The VPN says gateway not responding. How do I fix it?
answer: Some public networks block VPN traffic, so switch networks (for example to a phone hotspot) and retry. If authentication fails, your password may have expired; reset it and retry after five minutes.

question: Do I need the VPN for email and Slack?
answer: No. Email, Slack, PeopleHub and Google Drive work without the VPN. You only need it for internal systems such as Jenkins, staging environments, the finance ERP and internal wikis.

question: How do I set up MFA?
answer: Install Okta Verify on your phone, sign in at https://novatech.okta.com on your laptop, choose Okta Verify, scan the QR code and approve the test push. MFA is mandatory for every account.

question: I lost my phone with Okta Verify. What now?
answer: Call the IT Service Desk on extension 2020 immediately. IT removes the lost device, issues a temporary access code valid for 24 hours so you can enroll a new phone, and remotely wipes the work profile.

question: How do I request a software licence?
answer: Raise a Software Request in the IT Service Catalog at https://it.novatech.com/catalog with the software name, version and business justification. Your manager approves it; licences above $1,000 per year also need department-head approval. Already-licensed software takes about 2 business days, new software up to 7.

question: Can I install software myself?
answer: Yes, pre-approved tools such as Chrome, Zoom, Slack, VS Code, Postman, Docker Desktop, Python and Microsoft Office can be installed from NovaTech Software Center (Windows) or Self Service (macOS) without a ticket.

question: How do I get admin rights on my laptop?
answer: Local admin rights are not granted by default. Engineers can request Temporary Admin Access for 24 hours from the IT Service Catalog; it is auto-approved for Engineering and logged for audit.

question: How can a visitor get guest Wi-Fi?
answer: The host employee creates a guest pass at https://wifi.novatech.com/guest with the visitor's name, email or mobile number, and duration (up to 7 days). The visitor gets a voucher code by email or text message and connects to NovaTech-Guest. For more than 20 guests, request a bulk voucher 3 business days in advance.

question: Which Wi-Fi should I use on my personal phone?
answer: Use NovaTech-BYOD and sign in with your SSO credentials. You can register up to 2 personal devices. Company laptops connect automatically to NovaTech-Corp.

question: How do I set up work email on my phone?
answer: Use the official Gmail app. On Android install Android Device Policy, add your Google account and accept the work profile. On iOS install Google Device Policy and Gmail, sign in and install the management profile. The iOS Mail app and Outlook mobile are blocked.

question: When will my laptop be replaced?
answer: Laptops are refreshed every 3 years. IT emails you 30 days before your refresh date with a booking link. Early replacement needs manager approval and a documented issue.

question: My laptop was stolen. What should I do?
answer: Report it within 24 hours by calling extension 2020, file a police report and share the report number with IT. The first accidental-damage incident is covered by insurance; a second incident in a refresh cycle may be charged up to $500.

question: Can I get a loaner laptop while mine is repaired?
answer: Yes. Collect a loaner from the IT desk on the 3rd floor at the Minneapolis HQ, or the IT room in the Chicago and Denver offices, for up to 14 days.

question: When do I get my laptop as a new hire?
answer: Office new hires collect a pre-configured laptop at the IT desk on day one, around 2 PM after the Welcome session. Remote new hires receive it by courier 2 business days before their start date.

question: How much sick time do I get per year?
answer: Under Minnesota Earned Sick and Safe Time, you accrue 1 hour for every 30 hours worked, up to 48 hours (6 days) per year. Documentation can be requested only for more than 3 consecutive scheduled workdays. Unused sick time carries over (balance capped at 80 hours) but is not paid out.

question: How much PTO do I get?
answer: 15 days of PTO per year, accruing 1.25 days per month from your start date. You can use PTO after your 90-day introductory period. Apply at least 2 weeks in advance for 3 or more days.

question: Can I carry over or cash out my PTO?
answer: You can carry over up to 5 days of unused PTO into the next year; anything above that is forfeited on 31 December. Unused accrued PTO is paid out at your base rate when you leave. Sick and safe time carries over (up to an 80-hour balance) but is never paid out.

question: How long is parental leave?
answer: Every new parent (birth, adoption or foster) gets 12 weeks at full pay, taken within 12 months. Birthing parents get up to 6 additional weeks for pregnancy recovery. It runs alongside Minnesota Paid Leave and FMLA, and NovaTech tops up the state benefit to 100% of base pay.

question: What happens if I work on a weekend or holiday?
answer: Salaried (exempt) employees earn one substitute day off per full day worked; apply on PeopleHub within 7 days and use it within 60 days or it lapses. Hourly (non-exempt) employees are paid 1.5 times their rate for hours over 40 in a workweek.

question: Who approves my leave and what if they don't respond?
answer: Your reporting manager approves leave on PeopleHub. If they don't act within 3 business days, it auto-escalates to your skip-level manager. Absence without approval is unpaid, except sick and safe time.

question: What is the WFH policy?
answer: NovaTech is hybrid: 3 office days a week (anchor days Tuesday to Thursday) and up to 2 days from home, after the 90-day introductory period. Core hours are 10 AM to 4 PM CT. Fully remote work beyond 2 weeks needs manager and HR Business Partner approval.

question: Can I work from home during my introductory period?
answer: No. During the 90-day introductory period employees work from the office 5 days a week unless the manager approves otherwise. Hybrid eligibility starts after the introductory period.

question: Is there a home-office or internet allowance?
answer: Yes. After the introductory period you get a one-time $500 home-office allowance and up to $50 per month internet reimbursement, both claimed on PeopleHub with receipts.

question: How do I submit a reimbursement?
answer: On PeopleHub go to Expenses > New Claim, choose the category, enter amount, date and purpose, and upload receipts (an itemized receipt for any item over $75). Submit within 30 days of the expense. Your manager and then Finance approve it.

question: When will my reimbursement be paid?
answer: Claims approved by Finance by 5 PM CT on the Monday of a payday week are paid by direct deposit that Friday; later approvals are paid on the next payday. Reimbursements are not taxed. Claims older than 60 days are rejected.

question: What is the hotel limit for business travel?
answer: $250 per night in high-cost cities (New York, San Francisco, Boston, Chicago, Washington DC, Seattle) and $175 per night elsewhere, with a meals per diem of $75 per day. Domestic travel is economy air or rail through the travel desk.

question: Can I accept a gift from a vendor?
answer: You can accept gifts up to $100 in total per year per business partner. Anything above that must be declined or declared to Compliance. Cash and gift cards must never be accepted.

question: How do I report harassment?
answer: Report to HR Employee Relations at er@novatech.com, your HR Business Partner or any manager, or anonymously through the Ethics Hotline (https://ethics.novatech.com, 1-888-555-0167). Employee Relations acknowledges within 2 business days and normally completes the investigation within 30 days. You can also file with the EEOC or the Minnesota Department of Human Rights.

question: Can I do freelance work on the side?
answer: Outside employment or freelancing in the software industry needs written HR approval, and any conflict of interest must be declared on PeopleHub under Compliance > Conflict of Interest within 15 days.

question: When is the performance review?
answer: There is a mid-year check-in in July (no rating) and an annual review in January with self-assessment, peer feedback, manager assessment and calibration. Ratings are shared in February and merit increases take effect from 1 April.

question: What do I need to get promoted?
answer: Promotions are considered once a year in the annual cycle and need a rating of 4 or above and at least 18 months in your current level.

question: What do I do on my first day?
answer: Report to reception at 9:30 AM with your Form I-9 identity documents, collect your access badge, attend the Welcome session (10 AM to 1 PM), collect your laptop and set up SSO and MFA, have lunch with your team and buddy, and review your 30-60-90 day plan with your manager.

question: How do I enroll in health insurance?
answer: On PeopleHub open Benefits > Enrollment, choose a PPO or HDHP medical plan plus dental and vision, add your dependants and submit within 30 days of your start date. NovaTech pays 90% of employee premiums and 75% for dependants. Insurance ID cards arrive within 7 business days.

question: How long is the introductory period?
answer: The introductory period is 90 days, with check-ins at 30, 60 and 90 days. It can be extended once by up to 30 days. Employment is at-will, and NovaTech asks for 2 weeks' notice when you resign (4 weeks for managers).

question: What is the buddy program?
answer: Every new hire gets an onboarding buddy from a nearby team who meets them on day one and has weekly 30-minute chats for 6 weeks. Employees with at least 1 year at NovaTech can volunteer on PeopleHub under Programs > Buddy.

question: When is payday?
answer: NovaTech pays every other Friday by direct deposit (26 paychecks a year), or the Thursday before if Friday is a bank holiday. The payroll cut-off is 5 PM CT on the Monday of payday week, and pay statements are on PeopleHub on payday.

question: How do I fill in my tax withholding forms?
answer: Complete Form W-4 (federal) and Form W-4MN (Minnesota) on PeopleHub under Payroll > Tax Forms before your first payday; Chicago and Denver employees use their state's form. You can update them any time. Your W-2 is published on PeopleHub by 31 January.

question: How does stock option vesting work?
answer: Options vest over 4 years with a 1-year cliff: 25% vests on the first grant anniversary and the remaining 75% vests quarterly (6.25% per quarter) over the next 3 years. You exercise vested options in Carta.

question: What happens to my stock options if I leave?
answer: Unvested options are forfeited on your last day. Vested options must be exercised within 90 days of your last day or they expire. If terminated for cause, all options are forfeited.

question: Does NovaTech match my 401(k)?
answer: Yes. The 401(k) is with Fidelity and you are auto-enrolled at 3%. NovaTech matches 100% of the first 4% you contribute plus 50% of the next 2%, a maximum of 5% of eligible pay, and the match vests immediately.
